corrections.text: The article states, "PJM, which delivers power to 67 million people across 13 states and Washington, D.C., forecast that Thursday evening demand would exceed its 2006 record of 165,563 megawatts, according to Utility Dive." The cited Utility Dive article does not contain a population or state-count figure anywhere in its text — it reports only the 165,563 MW 2006 record and the DOE order details. The 13-states-plus-D.C. territory description and the approximately 65-67 million population figure are accurate and independently verifiable through PJM's own materials, but the citation to Utility Dive for this specific figure is incorrect.
